## Event simulator
Every minute: reads open cases, advances some of them, opens a few new ones, and posts the events to the **same public API** as any real source (`/webhook/events`).

`qa_review` advances slowly on purpose, so it turns into the bottleneck. Deactivate this workflow to freeze the data.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT coalesce(max(substring(case_id FROM 5)::int), 0)
     FROM process_events WHERE case_id ~ '^ORD-[0-9]+$') AS last_case_no,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('case_id', case_id, 'stage', current_stage)), '[]')
     FROM v_open_cases) AS open_cases;
